explanation: Use Pascal’s recurrence C(n,k)=C(n−1,k)+C(n−1,k−1), with boundary value one. The function-level memoization cache reuses computed pairs, including across calls.
timeComplexity: O(S) new memoized states; at most O(nk) for a fresh query
spaceComplexity: O(S_total) retained cache over the function lifetime, plus O(n) recursion
